title: Media Sentiment on Foreign Countries and International Asset Allocation
eligible_reason: No binary staggered treatment. Main tables regress country-fund flows on continuous media-sentiment measures (neg, att, neg x att) with fund, country and year-month FE and controls. The causal test (Table V) uses the WSJ acquisition by News Corp, a single common date (post), in a triple interaction with a continuous WSJ abnormal-negativity measure (abnegwsj x treat x post) plus controls.
design_notes: Fund-month panel of U.S. country-specific mutual funds (CRSP), 1990-2020; FE unique_id + country + ym; sample 2001m8-2013m8 for the WSJ test.
estimators_reported: OLS with fund, country, month FE on continuous sentiment
common-date triple difference with continuous intensity
n_adoption_cohorts_note: WSJ acquisition is one common event.
data_files_note: README: Factiva articles, CRSP mutual-fund data and Bloomberg country returns are not redistributed; only auxiliary country-level files are shipped.
software_notes: SAS for construction, Python / Qwen API for news classification, Stata for tables.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Continuous-sentiment design; single-date WSJ event.
